responsibility: Implements collect2’s cross-AIX compatibility layer for reading XCOFF objects and big archives without relying on native AIX ldfcn support. It parses big-endian file, archive, and symbol-table records defined in collect2-aix.h, maps archive members or standalone objects into memory, and provides the ldopen/ldtbread/ldgetname/ldclose subset that collect2 uses to scan constructor, destructor, and export-related symbols in AIX object files during link wrapping.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation side of the collect2-aix pair: it actually opens, maps, and parses AIX XCOFF objects and big archives, and implements the ldopen/ldtbread/ldgetname/ldclose compatibility routines used by collect2. Unlike gcc/collect2-aix.h, it does not define the record layouts and types; it uses them to perform cross-AIX object-file reading.
